item.name: Mailchimp Customer Journeys Api Trigger for a Contact

request.name: Mailchimp Customer Journeys Api Trigger for a Contact

description.content: A step trigger in a Customer Journey. To use it, create a starting point or step from the Customer Journey builder in the app using the Customer Journeys API condition. Well provide a url during the process that includes the {journey_id} and {step_id}. Youll then be able to use this endpoint to trigger the condition for the posted contact.
Added as a part of security scheme: basic
